svg.title: backward() over one neuron, o = tanh(x1 w1 + x2 w2 + b), one node at a time
svg.text: arrows: the forward pass, inputs to o. backward(): the grads, from o back to the inputs

g.title: The forward pass has run: each Value holds its number, the graph remembers how each was made, and every grad is still 0.
backward() starts at the output: o.grad = 1, since o moves one for one with itself.
tanh passes it back: the slope of tanh at n is 1 - o^2, so n.grad = 0.5591.
The + that made n passes n.grad back unchanged, to s and to b: 0.5591 each.
The + that made s passes s.grad back unchanged, to x1*w1 and to x2*w2: 0.5591 each.
The * that made x1*w1: each input gets (x1*w1).grad times the other input's value: x1.grad = 0.4472, w1.grad = 0.8386.
The * that made x2*w2: each input gets (x2*w2).grad times the other input's value: x2.grad = -0.6709, w2.grad = -0.2795. Every Value now holds d o / d itself, all from one pass.
